headline: Public Storage (PSA) Raises 2026 Guidance, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
summary: Public Storage (PSA) stock is in focus after the company raised its 2026 guidance, citing stronger occupancy and move-in rents, along with major portfolio moves including National Storage Affiliates and Public Storage Canada. See our latest analysis for Public Storage. The share price of Public Storage closed at US$324.17, with a 1 day share price return of 2.12% and a year to date share price return of 25.43%.
